strings.name: Jordan Peele
strings.summary: Peele moved from improvisation and television sketches into filmmaking. Get Out turned comic social observation into horror about racial power and won an original-screenplay Oscar. Us and Nope extended his work on identity and spectacle. Through Monkeypaw he also produces genre films by other directors.
